theories.claim: Additive QAEvidenceQueries type assertion creates shard-dependent 503 unavailable without stable guidance for Sprint 36 adapters
theories.basis: qa_handlers.go:24-28,38-42,51-55,74-78 etc assert h.qa.(app.QAEvidenceQueries) for evidence/adjudication/issues/assessment/smoke-suite while handlers.go:71-75 sets h.qa from opts.Operations.(app.QAQueries) or opts.Queries.(app.QAQueries). Comment in sprint_usecases.go:87-89 says QAEvidenceQueries is additive so older adapters implementing only QAQueries remain source-compatible. Handler returns ErrWebUnavailable (503) when assertion fails, but does not differentiate from nil qa case used for QAMap/QAStatus (qa_handlers.go:116-127).
theories.verification_surface: Integration: NewHandler with fakeQueries implementing only QAQueries (no QAEvidenceQueries) then GET /api/v1/projects/alpha/sprints/30-web/qa/issues, /qa/evidence/{id}, /qa/adjudication, /qa/assessment, /qa/smoke-suite
theories.confirmation_condition: Evidence-tier QA routes return 503 unavailable with generic The service is unavailable instead of explicit additive-capability diagnostic, while map/status/shard/theory/synthesis remain 200
theories.refutation_condition: All QA routes including evidence tier return either 200 via compatible adapter or consistent 503 with clear unavailable reasoning and no regression for legacy QAQueries
theories.inconclusive_condition: Cannot instantiate handler with partial adapter without execution
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Static inspection of handler type assertions vs HandlerOptions wiring and app.QAEvidenceQueries additive comment; request approved integration_test that covers both adapter shapes read-only

theories.claim: Missing upper-bound and method validation for QA evidence/adjudication/assessment/smoke routes allows unbounded or HEAD requests to reach use-case or bypass Allow header
theories.basis: qa_handlers.go:57-114 handleSprintQAIssues only checks Atoi error, delegates range to use-case; routes.go:373 allows map/synthesis/adjudication/issues/assessment/smoke-suite as GET-only via allowedMethods default (handlers.go:269-270 returns GET,HEAD for unknown matches), so HEAD is implicitly allowed for read-only QA but not validated against use-case expectations. No MaxIdentifierBytes or cursor size cap at web layer (handlers.go:1047-1053 validIdentifier only used in dispatch for param validation, not for query).
theories.verification_surface: HTTP API: HEAD /api/v1/projects/alpha/sprints/30-web/qa/issues, GET with limit=5000, GET with cursor length 10k, GET /api/v1/projects/alpha/sprints/30-web/qa/adjudication with stray query ?x=1
theories.confirmation_condition: HEAD returns 200 with body or truncated check, or large limit/cursor reaches use-case and returns 500 or allocates large base64 decode without 400
theories.refutation_condition: HEAD returns 200 with empty body and correct headers, large limit/cursor returns 400 invalid_request before use-case, and stray queries on non-paginated QA routes return 400
theories.inconclusive_condition: No execution to observe headResponseWriter behavior or cursor size handling
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Read handlers.go allowedMethods/dispatch and qa_handlers.go limit/cursor handling; request product-owned API compatibility or security test that probes HEAD and oversized query params read-only

theories.claim: Invalid limit values (non-numeric, negative, >200) are mapped to unstable 500 internal_error instead of stable public 400/422 qa.* contract
theories.basis: qa_handlers.go:59-63 parses limit with strconv.Atoi and only returns handleQueryError(w,r,true,err) where err is plain strconv error; for out-of-range, sprint_usecases.go:848-849 returns plain fmt.Errorf("issue page limit must be between 1 and 200") and sprint_usecases.go:857-859,862-873 returns plain fmt.Errorf for invalid/stale cursor. handlers.go:1056-1080 handleQueryError only maps QAUseCaseError to stable qa.* codes (422/409/503) and ErrWebNotFound/Unavailable to 404/503; all other plain errors fall through to 500 internal_error with message The request could not be completed, violating TestQAQueryErrorsUseStablePublicCodes pattern at qa_handlers_test.go:38-56
theories.confirmation_condition: Any of those requests returns 500 code=internal_error without category/guidance/correlation_id details instead of 400 invalid_request or 422 qa.invalid_state with stable details
theories.refutation_condition: All invalid limit/cursor requests return 400 invalid_request or 422 with stable qa.* code and details category/guidance/correlation_id, no internal_error leakage
theories.inconclusive_condition: Cannot execute requests or QAIssues use-case error mapping changed upstream to use QAUseCaseError
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Static review of qa_handlers.go limit parsing, sprint_usecases.go QAIssues validation, handlers.go handleQueryError/writeQAError branching; request approved check run of existing TestQAQueryErrorsUseStablePublicCodes plus new QAIssues validation test without custom execution

theories.claim: GET /api/v1/projects/{project}/sprints/{sprint}/qa/issues with ?limit and ?cursor is rejected by dispatch unknown-query guard before reaching handleSprintQAIssues
theories.basis: handlers.go:421-426 allowsQuery is limited to api_validations, api_runs, api_run_events, runs, api_timeline. qa_handlers.go:58-66 expects r.URL.Query().Get("limit") and "cursor" for api_sprint_qa_issues, but dispatch returns 400 invalid_request Unknown query parameters are not accepted for any non-allowed route, including api_sprint_qa_issues. Routes match api_sprint_qa_issues is known and api=true, but not in allowlist.
theories.verification_surface: HTTP API: GET /api/v1/projects/alpha/sprints/30-web/qa/issues?limit=10, GET with ?cursor=<base64>, GET with ?limit=200&cursor=..., observe status and error code vs expected paginated QAIssuePage
theories.confirmation_condition: Request with valid limit/cursor returns 400 code=invalid_request message Unknown query parameters are not accepted instead of 200 QAIssuePage or mapped QA error
theories.refutation_condition: Same requests return 200 with paginated payload (or 422 for invalid limit/cursor) and Content-Type application/json schema_version 1
theories.inconclusive_condition: Cannot invoke HTTP handler (no execution) or route matching differs from handlers.go:372-383
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Read-only static review of handlers.go dispatch allowlist vs routes.go qa issue routes and qa_handlers.go query reads; request product-owned check routing or API integration test that exercises limit/cursor without writing files or executing shell
